map.过去一个月内的睡眠情况: Sleep situation over the past month
map.1. 近1个月，每晚实际睡眠时间（小时）: 1. Over the past month, actual nightly sleep time (hours)
map.2. 近1个月，每晚卧床时间（小时）: 2. Over the past month, nightly time in bed (hours)
map.3. 近1个月，每晚通常需多久入睡（分钟）: 3. Over the past month, usual time to fall asleep nightly (minutes)
map.4. 近1个月，因30分钟内不能入睡而难以入睡的频率: 4. Over the past month, frequency of trouble falling asleep due to inability to sleep within 30 minutes
map.5b. 夜间需起床上厕所: 5b. Need to get up to use bathroom at night
map.6. 近1个月，使用催眠药物的频率: 6. Over the past month, frequency of using sleep medication
map.7. 近1个月，开车/吃饭/社交时难以保持清醒的频率: 7. Over the past month, frequency of difficulty staying awake while driving/eating/socializing
map.8. 近1个月，保持足够热情完成事情的程度: 8. Over the past month, level of staying enthusiastic enough to get things done
map.9. 近1个月，主观睡眠质量: 9. Over the past month, subjective sleep quality
map.睡眠质量好，无明显睡眠问题: Good sleep quality, no obvious sleep problems

map.睡眠质量较差，存在中度睡眠问题: Poor sleep quality, moderate sleep problems present
map.睡眠质量很差，存在严重睡眠障碍: Very poor sleep quality, severe sleep disorders present
map.PSQI总分＞7分提示存在睡眠障碍（灵敏度89.6%，特异性86.5%）。7个成: PSQI total >7 suggests sleep disorder (sensitivity 89.6%, specificity 86.5%). Seven component scores (subjective sleep quality, sleep latency, sleep duration, sleep efficiency, sleep disturbances, sleep medication, daytime dysfunction) each 0-3. Widely used for insomnia, depression/anxiety-related insomnia, sleep apnea. Combine with sleep diary and polysomnography (PSG).
map.失眠、睡眠呼吸/不宁腿筛查。: Insomnia, sleep-disordered breathing / restless legs screening.
map.主观 2+潜伏期 2+效率 2+时长 2+紊乱 1+药物 1+日间 2=12 分: Subjective 2 + latency 2 + efficiency 2 + duration 2 + disturbance 1 + medication 1 + daytime 2 = 12 >7: poor sleep quality.
map.7 个成分合计 >7 提示睡眠质量差。: Sum of 7 components >7 suggests poor sleep quality.
map.主观、潜伏期、效率、时长、紊乱、药物、日间功能，各 0~3。: Subjective, latency, efficiency, duration, disturbance, medication, daytime function, each 0-3.
